chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Hasan, from Suleyman Al-Ja'fari, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: 'Pray one hundred cycles on the night of the twenty-first and the night of the twenty-third, reciting in each cycle, "Say: He, Allah, is One" ten times.'

key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say: He, Allah, is One (Surah Al-Ikhlas)

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed prayer for the nights of 21st and 23rd Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi prescribes a specific night prayer (Salat) for the 21st and 23rd nights of Ramadan, coinciding with the Imams' practices during Laylat al-Qadr. It mandates one hundred rak'ahs in total, with the recitation of Surah Al-Ikhlas ten times per cycle, emphasizing the spiritual significance of these nights in Shia tradition. The practice reflects the scholarly emphasis on devotion and the unique status of these nights in the latter part of Ramadan.
